top_story.headline: Rep. Dan Crenshaw still has no 2025 annual financial disclosure on file, 69 days past his final extension
top_story.dek: He is the only sitting member of Congress in the Deadline Watch check with no CY2025 annual report on file after every extension has run out.
paragraphs: Rep. Dan Crenshaw (R-TX-2) filed for an extension on June 4, 2026. The final extension date was August 13, 2026, and no annual report has appeared since. That puts him 69 days past the last allowed date.

The check compared every sitting member against the Clerk of the House index and Senate eFD. Members sworn in after Nov. 1 of the report year are excluded. The script's own caveat applies: a filing under an unexpected spelling of a name can look like a missing one.

The same check found 7 Senate-confirmed officials with no posted certification of ethics-agreement compliance more than 30 days past deadline. The longest overdue is Michelle White Bowman, Governor and Vice Chairman for Supervision of the Federal Reserve System Board of Governors, confirmed June 4, 2025, with certification due September 2, 2025 (414 days ago).

sections.eyebrow: Contacts With the President, VP & Cabinet
sections.headline: No logged contact with the President, Vice President or a cabinet member today; one filing carries a chatbot fingerprint
paragraphs: Of the two new FARA filings in the scan, neither shows a logged communication with the President, Vice President or a cabinet-level official. Six LDA filings name the President, the Vice President or an official in what was lobbied.

items: Clock Tower X LLC (FARA #7649), informational materials for the foreign principal State of Israel via Havas Media Germany GmbH (Israel): the filing's text carries three ChatGPT-style citation markers, such as utm_source=chatgpt.com links, including the string “turn821482search1”. sections.headline: Ambassador Nominee Files Ethics Agreement
paragraphs: Christian Ehrhardt, nominated as Ambassador to the Republic of Cameroon, filed his ethics agreement with the Department of State outlining his ethical commitments for the position. The agreement commits him to recuse himself from matters involving companies with a presence in Cameroon and to seek prior approval for any investment purchases outside of diversified mutual funds, cash, or government obligations. He will file a Certification of Ethics Agreement Compliance within 90 days of confirmation.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.

sections.headline: Rep. Debbie Dingell filed 7 trade reports last year, none in 91 days
paragraphs: 1 House member(s) with a history of frequent stock trading have stopped filing trade reports.

items: Rep. Debbie Dingell (D-MI-6) filed 7 periodic transaction reports in the 12 months from 7/23/2025 to 7/23/2026, and none in the 91 days since the last, on 7/22/2026

blocks.text: House members who filed 6 or more periodic transaction reports (STOCK Act trade disclosures) in the year before the last 90 days and none since, per the House Clerk's disclosure index. Silence doesn't say why: the member may have sold off holdings, moved assets into a blind trust or index fund, been covered by a new law, or just not traded -- and trades are reportable up to 45 days late, so the latest ones may not be filed yet. House members only; the Senate's e-filing search isn't covered.
